scope: PSA Restricted seccomp admission for regular, init, and ephemeral containers; Pod-level RuntimeDefault inheritance and explicit per-container RuntimeDefault are observed on a pinned kind node. A read-only custom Localhost profile denies only the uname syscall in a benign pinned Python fixture. Other runtimes, The additional fixture exercises a digest-pinned Security Profiles Operator and actual versioned ProfileBinding selection on its owned node. Production syscall minima and exception approval, multi-node/managed coverage, and real workload availability require separate evidence.
